What docker system df prints, column by column:

TYPE            TOTAL     ACTIVE    SIZE      RECLAIMABLE
Images          72        12        94.26GB   80.05GB (84%)

TOTAL is how many there are and ACTIVE how many a container uses; SIZE is
what they take up and RECLAIMABLE what a prune would free, with the share
of the size in parentheses. The build cache row prints no share.
